_about: Model files used by runners/*.py. They are NOT committed: put them under $EZLG_BENCH_MODELS (default: ./models next to this file) or run tools/fetch-models.sh, which downloads and sha256-checks all three. Every file is a plain ONNX graph executed by onnxruntime; no remote code.
release: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/tag/v0.0.0 (rembg's model mirror; rembg itself is MIT, (c) 2020 Daniel Gatis)

u2netp.onnx.graph: opset 11, input 'input.1' float32 [1,3,320,320], 7 sigmoid outputs; output 0 is the fused d0 prediction

isnet-anime.onnx.upstream: SkyTNT/anime-segmentation (ISNet / DIS); byte-identical to HF skytnt/anime-seg isnetis.onnx at revision 493cb60893f47441b26ec4fb9a306bce9e342982 (same LFS sha256)
isnet-anime.onnx.license: Apache-2.0 (github.com/SkyTNT/anime-segmentation LICENSE; HF card license: apache-2.0)
isnet-anime.onnx.graph: opset 11, input 'img' float32 [1,3,1024,1024], output 'mask' float32 [1,1,1024,1024] (sigmoid already applied); Resize nodes carry absolute sizes, so the graph only runs at its baked-in size

BiRefNet-general-bb_swin_v1_tiny-epoch_2.upstream: ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet (BiRefNet_lite: general-use training set, swin_v1_tiny backbone, epoch 232)
BiRefNet-general-bb_swin_v1_tiny-epoch_2.graph: fixed batch 1, 3x1024x1024 float32 input, [1,1,1024,1024] logits output (the runner applies the sigmoid)

derived._about: Made on first use by runners/isnet-anime-onnx.py next to the source file; tools/to_fp16.py and tools/rescale_graph.py are the scripts. sha256 values are those of the research run's files (names there: isnet-anime.fp16.onnx, isnet-anime.512.onnx, isnet-anime.512.fp16.onnx).

isnet-anime.fp16.onnx.how: python -I tools/to_fp16.py isnet-anime.onnx isnet-anime.fp16.onnx (ISNET_ANIME_PRECISION=fp16, the default on cuda)

isnet-anime.512.onnx.how: python -I tools/rescale_graph.py isnet-anime.onnx isnet-anime.512.onnx 512 (ISNET_ANIME_SIZE=512 with ISNET_ANIME_PRECISION=fp32, the CPU configuration of the proposal)

isnet-anime.fp16.512.onnx.how: rescale_graph.py 512 applied to the fp16 file (ISNET_ANIME_SIZE=512 on cuda)
